title: Incident with noisy chatter
attack: incident facts mixed with irrelevant chatter

messages.content: Incident notes, with noise: someone pasted lunch orders, ignore that. Incident ID INC-AUTH-4421 started 16:08 UTC. Login success rate fell to 91.4%. Impact was 7,820 failed logins. Root cause: JWKS cache used kid=old-17 after rotation. Mitigation: forced JWKS refresh and pinned kid=new-18. Owner Omar. Follow-up: add alert if stale_jwks_age_seconds > 300 for 3 minutes.
Auth incident INC-AUTH-4421 at 16:08 UTC, 91.4%, 7,820 failed logins, stale JWKS kid old-17/new-18, Omar owner.
